dasha.year: true sidereal solar year: the Sun advancing 360° in the sidereal zodiac, with the chart's own positions

vargas.D2: Hora: Parashara (Cancer-Leo): odd signs Leo then Cancer, even signs Cancer then Leo
vargas.D3: Drekkana: the sign, then its 5th, then its 9th
vargas.D4: Chaturthamsa: the sign, then its 4th, 7th and 10th
vargas.D7: Saptamsa: odd signs from the sign, even signs from its 7th
vargas.D9: Navamsa: each 3°20′ from 0° Aries steps one sign
vargas.D10: Dasamsa: odd signs from the sign, even signs from its 9th
vargas.D16: Shodasamsa: movable signs from Aries, fixed from Leo, dual from Sagittarius
vargas.D20: Vimsamsa: movable signs from Aries, fixed from Sagittarius, dual from Leo
vargas.D24: Chaturvimsamsa: odd signs from Leo, even signs from Cancer
vargas.D27: Saptavimsamsa: fire signs from Aries, earth from Cancer, air from Libra, water from Capricorn
vargas.D30: Trimsamsa: Parashara: odd signs Aries 5°, Aquarius 5°, Sagittarius 8°, Gemini 7°, Libra 5°; even signs Taurus 5°, Virgo 7°, Pisces 8°, Capricorn 5°, Scorpio 5°
vargas.D40: Khavedamsa: odd signs from Aries, even signs from Libra
vargas.D45: Akshavedamsa: movable signs from Aries, fixed from Leo, dual from Sagittarius

avakhada.from: the Moon: sign for varna, vashya and tatva; nakshatra for yoni, gana and nadi; pada for the name syllable
avakhada.varna: Muhurta Chintamani: water signs Brahmin, fire Kshatriya, earth Vaishya, air Shudra
avakhada.vashya: Sagittarius Manava then Chatushpada, Capricorn Chatushpada then Jalachara, split at 15°
avakhada.syllables: Hoda Chakra of 27 nakshatras (Shravana खी खू खे खो)
